About Junior

We’re building cutting-edge LLM-powered workflow tools to supercharge investment research for private market investors. Our clients include most of the global top 10 private equity and consulting firms - Junior already powers hundreds of billions of dollars invested annually. We’re a profitable, bootstrapped company with a growing team of 50+ based in London, NYC and Sydney. We 10x’d our revenue in 2025.

You can read more about the company mission & values here.

Role Description

You will own and manage our quote-to-cash cycle, finance operations, and accounting function with decision making authority on what should be in-housed, outsourced, and automated. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own and manage the full quote-to-cash cycle including

    • Quote & contract structure

    • Managing our invoicing system & generating invoices

    • Collections & cash application

    • Revenue recognition & the close

    • Working with engineers / data scientists to implement new invoicing models for usage-based pricing agreements

  • Drive automation of repetitive tasks

    • Use AI finance solutions and leverage our technical staff to run a highly automated, lean finance function

jobs.jd:
About the Role

Join the go-to-market team at a Series A HR technology company and help build its outbound sales engine. You will connect with HR, Finance, and executive leaders at multinational businesses, helping grow a modern employee benefits platform.

What You'll Do

  • Generate top-of-funnel pipeline and aim to book approximately 10 qualified meetings per month.

  • Reach enterprise prospects through cold calls, email, LinkedIn, and creative outbound campaigns.

  • Partner with Account Executives to qualify opportunities and support effective handoffs.

  • Use AI tools and modern sales technology to automate manual tasks and increase outreach effectiveness.

  • Share prospect feedback and market insights with Product and Leadership to inform positioning and go-to-market strategy.

What We're Looking For

  • One to three years of outbound BDR or SDR experience selling HR technology in a B2B SaaS environment.

  • A record of achieving or exceeding quota, ideally at a high-growth startup from Seed through Series C.

  • Confident cold-calling skills and experience engaging senior HR, Finance, and C-suite stakeholders.

  • Experience with CRM systems, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, email outreach tools, and ChatGPT or other AI tools for sales workflows.

  • Experience working in a hybrid team environment.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary is £40,000 to £43,00
